reuse.why: No guard existed; it adds one assertBankAccountNotLinked helper and reuses it in every provider link function.

duplication.why: Query and message are defined once; each provider passes only its own values.

placement.why: Placed beside the link functions in accounts/app.ts ahead of any write; accounts/link.ts, which holds findOrCreateBank, would be an equally natural home.

scope.why: Guard, five calls and a release note; nothing unrelated.

maintainability.why: One definition of the rule, but the provider is typed as a plain string instead of AccountSyncSource, so a misspelled provider would go unnoticed.

one_place.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts, called first by all five provider link functions
